data.name: BLOK
data.detailed_description:
BLOK is a free puzzle platformer built by seven young game developers in a class at Code & Circuit, a STEM non-profit running creative tech programs for kids. Each student was handed the same toolkit and asked the same question: what kind of puzzle would you make?

The result is an anthology. Five student-designed levels, each with its own setting, ideas, and personality, plus a tutorial level to teach you the ropes. Some levels will have you shuttling a single block through a gauntlet of puzzles. Others hand you a pile of colors and a wall of buttons. The boxing glove and grappling plunger show up where their designers wanted them to — sometimes essential, sometimes nowhere in sight.

All levels are unlocked from the start. Pick whichever one catches your eye from the level select and dive in.

Features

  • Five original levels designed by students, plus a tutorial

  • Carry colored blocks on BLOK's head to solve color-matching puzzles

  • Punch through walls with the boxing glove

  • Swing across obstacles with the grappling plunger

  • Free to play — a showcase of what young developers can build

About the developers

BLOK was made by seven students in a game development class run by JimDublace Studios in partnership with Code & Circuit. The class introduces young developers to the full process of shipping a real game — from design and production through to publishing on Steam.

data.short_description: BLOK is a free puzzle platformer made by students at Code & Circuit, a local STEM non-profit. Carry colored blocks to matching buttons, smash through walls with a boxing glove, and swing across gaps with a grappling plunger across a tutorial and five student-designed levels.
